components.name: Button
components.summary: Starts an action; primary (wx-btn-primary, brand fill, on-brand text) at most once per view — usually «Порівняти вихідні» or the search submit.

components.name: CitySearch
components.summary: The hero's centered combobox: free-form city input, debounced Open-Meteo geocoding suggestions, and the opt-in «Використати моє місцезнаходження» button beneat…

components.name: ComfortBadge
components.summary: Shows a day's 0–100 comfort score as number plus word on one of three fills.

components.name: DayCard
components.summary: One of the seven daily forecast cards: weekday and date, condition icon, hi/lo, precipitation probability, wind, comfort badge.

components.name: WeekendHighlight
components.summary: The headline answer above the seven-day grid: is the upcoming weekend worth going for, at this place.

components.name: CompareTable
components.summary: Side-by-side weekend comparison of up to three pinned cities.

components.name: Notice
components.summary: The calm inline state for empty results and failed requests — the product's answer to "honest under failure".
